comparison.objective: Orient floor monitors into microphone nulls at specified cardioid and supercardioid angles.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object angular placement based on acoustic geometry rather than unlocking, fine collar adjustment, torque-limited relocking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Monitor angles of 180° or 126° versus two safe physical stops and retained damper setting. Angular tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation is generic; the prior task tests static acoustic orientation, while the candidate tests a retained mechanical setting through dynamic performance.
